content_blocks.run_instructions: This illustrates command grouping. Redis transactions do not offer relational-style rollback for runtime command errors; handle those explicitly.
content_blocks.note: Use a disposable development keyspace. Treat this as a learning example, not a production-ready policy without boundary tests.
